conclusion: In this synthetic medium workload, every call re-sends the whole history, so 5x more calls (10 to 50) means 24.0x more input tokens; a 30-call task sends 5,467x the input tokens of one chat (94.0% of it re-sent history) and costs 277x one chat at illustrative prices, not reaching 1,000 chats in cost even at 50 calls (752x), while prompt caching cuts that 30-call cost by 82.0% without reducing tokens.
setup: N calls 5/10/20/30/50 (calls 1..N-1 use a tool, call N answers); synthetic profiles light/medium/heavy keep 20/50/100% of the same per-step tool outputs; independent per-step seeds from base seed 7; each full request serialized as JSON and counted; tokens estimated by a word-piece rule (cross-checked with chars/4), not a model tokenizer; code-shaped text from this lab's own source; illustrative USD per 1M: input 3, output 15, cache read 0.3, cache write 3.75; simulation, not a billed run
